gold_liquidity_analysis: XAUUSD experienced a major institutional liquidity sweep downwards to 3511.3 before aggressively reversing upwards with high volume (20,361 on the impulsive breakout candle). Current price action shows a healthy pullback/consolidation around 3554.1 after tagging an intraday high of 3567.4. Lower timeframes show strong buying pressure supporting any dip below 3550, while DXY remains tightly bound near 104.07, providing a stable macro backdrop for gold continuation.
trade_thesis: Following the aggressive liquidity purge of early session lows, institutional order flow has shifted firmly bullish on XAUUSD. The asset has established a higher-low structure on the 15-minute timeframe. Entering on the minor pullback towards 3554 aligns with continuation momentum targeting the previous intraday high and liquidity pools resting above 3570.
